fnv1a64.operation: For each raw byte: (hash XOR byte) * prime modulo 2^64. No length prefix or framing is included.

dictionary_reachable_accounting: The original fresh Encoder had no allocated codec payload before its first process call, so the equal retained_capacity_before observed across all three fresh strategy records is exactly the selected persistent dictionary reachable capacity. It remains selected throughout this capture. Subtracting it produces owned codec totals, not search-only totals.
narrow_search_capacity: Not measured by ba4529c public API; never inferred as zero or as total minus dictionary.
derivation: All data hashes and FNV values were derived from saved pre-change input/dictionary/output bytes after SHA256/length revalidation. No source regeneration or codec execution occurred.
